/* Recaulk: the API_* availability macros of later SDKs (os/availability.h), each platform's clause its own
   availability attribute, so a later SDK's spellings reach clang as the same attributes. */
#ifndef API_AVAILABLE
#define __RECAULK_API_I_macos(v) macos,introduced=v
#define __RECAULK_API_I_macosx(v) macos,introduced=v
#define __RECAULK_API_I_ios(v) ios,introduced=v
#define __RECAULK_API_I_tvos(v) tvos,introduced=v
#define __RECAULK_API_I_watchos(v) watchos,introduced=v
#define __RECAULK_API_I_macCatalyst(v) maccatalyst,introduced=v
#define __RECAULK_API_I_driverkit(v) driverkit,introduced=v
#define __RECAULK_API_D_macos(a, d) macos,introduced=a,deprecated=d
#define __RECAULK_API_D_macosx(a, d) macos,introduced=a,deprecated=d
#define __RECAULK_API_D_ios(a, d) ios,introduced=a,deprecated=d
#define __RECAULK_API_D_tvos(a, d) tvos,introduced=a,deprecated=d
#define __RECAULK_API_D_watchos(a, d) watchos,introduced=a,deprecated=d
#define __RECAULK_API_D_macCatalyst(a, d) maccatalyst,introduced=a,deprecated=d
#define __RECAULK_API_D_driverkit(a, d) driverkit,introduced=a,deprecated=d
#define __RECAULK_API_U_macos macos
#define __RECAULK_API_U_macosx macos
#define __RECAULK_API_U_ios ios
#define __RECAULK_API_U_tvos tvos
#define __RECAULK_API_U_watchos watchos
#define __RECAULK_API_U_macCatalyst maccatalyst
#define __RECAULK_API_U_driverkit driverkit
#define __RECAULK_API_A(x) __attribute__((availability(__RECAULK_API_I_##x)))
#define __RECAULK_API_U(x) __attribute__((availability(__RECAULK_API_U_##x,unavailable)))
#define __RECAULK_API_D(m, x) __attribute__((availability(__RECAULK_API_D_##x,message=m)))
#define __RECAULK_API_R(r, x) __attribute__((availability(__RECAULK_API_D_##x,replacement=r)))
#define __RECAULK_API_PICK(_1, _2, _3, _4, _5, _6, N, ...) N
#define __RECAULK_API_EACH1(F, a) F(a)
#define __RECAULK_API_EACH2(F, a, ...) F(a) __RECAULK_API_EACH1(F, __VA_ARGS__)
#define __RECAULK_API_EACH3(F, a, ...) F(a) __RECAULK_API_EACH2(F, __VA_ARGS__)
#define __RECAULK_API_EACH4(F, a, ...) F(a) __RECAULK_API_EACH3(F, __VA_ARGS__)
#define __RECAULK_API_EACH5(F, a, ...) F(a) __RECAULK_API_EACH4(F, __VA_ARGS__)
#define __RECAULK_API_EACH6(F, a, ...) F(a) __RECAULK_API_EACH5(F, __VA_ARGS__)
#define __RECAULK_API_EACH(F, ...) __RECAULK_API_PICK(__VA_ARGS__, __RECAULK_API_EACH6, __RECAULK_API_EACH5, \
    __RECAULK_API_EACH4, __RECAULK_API_EACH3, __RECAULK_API_EACH2, __RECAULK_API_EACH1, 0)(F, __VA_ARGS__)
#define __RECAULK_API_EACHM1(F, m, a) F(m, a)
#define __RECAULK_API_EACHM2(F, m, a, ...) F(m, a) __RECAULK_API_EACHM1(F, m, __VA_ARGS__)
#define __RECAULK_API_EACHM3(F, m, a, ...) F(m, a) __RECAULK_API_EACHM2(F, m, __VA_ARGS__)
#define __RECAULK_API_EACHM4(F, m, a, ...) F(m, a) __RECAULK_API_EACHM3(F, m, __VA_ARGS__)
#define __RECAULK_API_EACHM5(F, m, a, ...) F(m, a) __RECAULK_API_EACHM4(F, m, __VA_ARGS__)
#define __RECAULK_API_EACHM6(F, m, a, ...) F(m, a) __RECAULK_API_EACHM5(F, m, __VA_ARGS__)
#define __RECAULK_API_EACHM(F, m, ...) __RECAULK_API_PICK(__VA_ARGS__, __RECAULK_API_EACHM6, __RECAULK_API_EACHM5, \
    __RECAULK_API_EACHM4, __RECAULK_API_EACHM3, __RECAULK_API_EACHM2, __RECAULK_API_EACHM1, 0)(F, m, __VA_ARGS__)
#define API_AVAILABLE(...) __RECAULK_API_EACH(__RECAULK_API_A, __VA_ARGS__)
#define API_UNAVAILABLE(...) __RECAULK_API_EACH(__RECAULK_API_U, __VA_ARGS__)
#define API_DEPRECATED(m, ...) __RECAULK_API_EACHM(__RECAULK_API_D, m, __VA_ARGS__)
#define API_DEPRECATED_WITH_REPLACEMENT(r, ...) __RECAULK_API_EACHM(__RECAULK_API_R, r, __VA_ARGS__)
#endif
